projects.name: Sallah bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot written in Python that sends prayer-time reminders based on the user's city, used by about 1,200 people. Runs on a self-managed, patched Ubuntu server accessed via SSH. Stores user city and reminder preferences in SQLite with hand-written tables and queries. Identified and fixed a time-zone bug causing late Fajr reminders for users outside the Kingdom, and added a check to prevent recurrence.

projects.name: Tutor Match
projects.description: A website for University of Tabuk students to find peer tutors for courses, built with a plain JavaScript frontend and a Flask backend returning tutor data as JSON. Development history is public with about 140 commits, using one branch per feature tested before merging. Gained 85 student sign-ups in the first term.
